evidence: McTavish et al. 2025, AvesData release 1.3 (github.com/McTavishLab/AvesData, Tree_versions/Aves_1.3/Clements2023): summary_dated_clements.nex 'DIMENSIONS NTAX=11017;' against NTAX=10824 in the Clements2021 folder used here; phylo_only_clements_labels.tre (tips placed by an input phylogeny) 9,189 tips against 9,239 in Clements2021, counted on the held copies (Data/raw/revision-2026-10/birds/AvesData_other_versions/Aves_1.3_Clements2023_summary_dated_clements.nex and Aves_1.3_Clements2023_phylo_only_clements_labels.tre, sha256 in SHA256SUMS), equal to Table 1 of the paper (2021: 10,824 species, 9,239 with phylogenetic information; 2023: 11,017 and 9,189). The crosswalk to the Open Tree taxonomy covers all 10,824 Clements 2021 species and 10,765 of 11,017 Clements 2023 species (Materials and Methods). Same synthesis, later taxonomy version; not used, by the rule stated in Methods for a synthesis aligned to several taxonomy versions (D56). Checked 2026-10-08.
